name: Perapera
source:
When Maria is absent, two Twin nurses (Twiners) are dispatched to take care of Hiroki.

Her “treatment” begins with a talk and ends with a talk. It is very doubtful whether Maria can fulfill that role.

She is taller than 180 cm. She is an apprentice so her skills are not very developed yet.
